Indian cities face water scarcity amid heatwave and low dam levels

Several Indian cities are experiencing significant water scarcity due to a severe heatwave and falling dam levels, exacerbated by delayed monsoon rains. Authorities are exploring measures such as artificial rain and stricter water usage regulations to mitigate the crisis. Experts also point to deeper underlying causes for the declining water levels.
